question.text:
Real 3 × 3 matrices A, B satisfy rank A = 2 and AB = 0. What is the greatest possible rank of
B?
(A) 0
(B) 1
(C) 2
(D) 3
(E) The conditions are impossible.

solution.text:
Every column of B lies in the one-dimensional nullspace of A, so rank B ≤ 1. Equality oc-
curs with A = diag(1, 1, 0) and B = diag(0, 0, 1). A zero product does not force either ma-
trix to be zero.
